entities.summary: Dorjnyambuugiin Otgondalai is a Mongolian lightweight boxer. He won a gold medal at the 2014 Asian Games and a bronze medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He was the flag bearer for Mongolia during the closing ceremony of the 2016 Summer Olympics.
